facts: A planned city, founded in 1913 to a design by Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin
worth_knowing: Canberra exists because Sydney and Melbourne each wanted to be the capital. The compromise was a new city in New South Wales, at least 160 km from Sydney.
